title: People-in-Photos Frequency
dataSources: Photos (`photo:capture`), places visited (`location:visit`), voice memos (`voicememo:note`), logged moments (`lifelog:moment`), timeline events (`timeline:event`).
app: Life-logging and memory telemetry — photo libraries (Google Photos, Immich), location history, voice memos, and daily-moment journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=photo:capture
| stats count as photos by person
| where person!=""
| sort - photos
| head 15
description: Counts who appears most in your photos, gently revealing the people you spend the most time with.
value: Seeing who fills your photo library is a heartfelt reminder of the relationships at the centre of your life.
implementation: Ingest photo people-tags into `index=personal`; count photos per person.
visualization: Bar chart of photo counts by person.
grandmaExplanation: It counts who shows up most in your photos, a warm reminder of the people closest to you.
